peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 25% below its local comparables; 2 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (73.2): 4.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 295 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,700,000 ($1,886 psf, 1,420–1,485 sq ft; 6 resales, Jan 2024–Dec 2025); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,515 psf (range $2,255–4,061); 25% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $900,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Stevens MRT about 380 m, Newton MRT about 1,110 m; closer than 320 of 551 similar developments (the same as 16). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Singapore Chinese Girls' Primary School about 290 m; more than 310 of 551 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 260 m), more than 34 of 551 similar developments (the same as 38); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 1,340 m; nearest park Malcolm Park about 490 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 220 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 640 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,090 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,380 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,680 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 1,910 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 302 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 78 new sales and 723 resales (801 purchases); new sales were 9.7% of these purchases. Subsales (22) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,040 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,190 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 723 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 141 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 723 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 741 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−2.4%). Planning-area private resales −14%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
